channels.description: Where this notice was published. Prefer canonical channel IDs from artifacts/registries/official-channels.csv (e.g., official_website, status_page) so parity checks are unambiguous.

correction_of.description: DEPRECATED alias for correction_of_notice_id (kept for backwards compatibility). Prefer correction_of_notice_id. If both are present, correction_of_notice_id is authoritative.

correction_of_notice_id.description: If notice_type==correction, the notice_id being corrected. Prefer this field (not correction_of).

message.description: Short, plain-language statement intended to be mirrored verbatim.

milestone_id.description: If notice_type==election_milestone, a stable milestone identifier (see artifacts/registries/election-milestones.csv).

next_update_at.description: Optional measurable commitment: when the next update will be published (if applicable).

notice_id.description: Stable identifier for this notice (content may change via corrections).

notice_version.description: Schema version of this notice payload.

related_trigger_event_id.description: Optional trigger event_id this notice addresses (PublicationTriggerEvent).

supersedes_notice_id.description: If this notice supersedes a previous notice, record its notice_id.
